integrity: All finite objects are generated by standalone exhaustive Python programs and compared to a complete adjacency certificate. The 2004-08-18 date is the earliest verified day-specific online source date used to document this mathematical setting; an earlier 2000 publication has only year-level date evidence and is acknowledged, not assigned a fabricated day.
scientific_claim: The 33 perfect matchings of GP(8,3) under all simple six-cycle flips form a thirty-vertex connected component of diameter four plus three isolated matchings; sign parity gives exact reachability after singleton exceptions.
scientific_limitations: One graph GP(8,3), only flips along simple abstract six-cycles; not arbitrary even-cycle flips or only the faces of one embedding. Historical priority and independent mathematical audit remain open.
title: Parity and connectivity of hexagon flips on the Möbius–Kantor graph
